Name: Bragds Leah
Author: CaptainBragd
Description:
Like my mod? Suport me on [url=https://commiss.io/captainbragd]Commissio [/url]or [url=https://ko-fi.com/captainbragd]Ko-fi[/url] :)


WHOOPS! Game has had some more updates to Leah stuff than I was aware of when I tried updating this the other day. I had missed out on winter clothes and beach wear being in the vanilla game these days. So my update did not cover those, I'll make sure to Do Something About It soon enough!


I wanted my own take on a chubby Leah and then decided to make her some outfits for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/649/?]RTGOATs Longevity mod[/url].

 My version is inspired by SyAblemans [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/542/?]Chubby Bachellorettes[/url] mod a lot, check it out!

 If you just want the basic sprite for her, I recomend you use the "Leah Sprites" file. Please note that you only need Longevity if you are aiming to use the files with that mod.

 1. download and unzip the file.
 2. copy and replace the Content file in the games content folder.
 3. have fun <3


DISCLAIMER, I have not kept up to date with Stardew valley for a long time, and even less so with the Longevity mod so I dont know if my old mod for it is still applicable. It probably isn't since its lacking a few of Leahs newer frames, even if nothing else has changed about Longevity. I'll let the files stay up till I figure out if I want to make an updated version of them. So take the following instructions with a pinch of salt:

If you want to use the sprites with Longevity, use the Longevity Leah file.

 1. Download and unzip the file.
 2. Copy and replace the DNPCC folder into the Longevity folder.
